Nice family food restaurant!
Dec 2022
This was our revisit after our last visit in 2019 (before Covid19) and that left us great impression and so decided to revisit again.

The restaurant is located in De Tham street, where many family restaurants are located. If you are a first time visitor, you maybe spoiled for choice which restaurant to visit as all look "good"!

For us, without hesitation, we went to this restaurant. And surprisingly it was quite empty although it was 7.30pm in the evening. Only 2 tables were occupied (on 2nd storey, including ours). Think Covid19 has hit hard on the small and medium businesses here.

We ordered the pork ribs with fried rice, BBQ clams, stir fried cauliflowers and water spinach and deep fried chicken. We didn't order the BBQ oysters and beef dishes as we just had them the night before and wanted something "light".

Portions were huge, And the food were yummy, well marinated and cooked to perfection, consistently good no doubt in that! And prices were reasonable too, despite of inflation, the price did not rise or rise slightly like 5000 dong only.

Our dinner at around 220,000 dong. We didn't order any drink as we had plan to visit a cafe for iced beverages as the weather was warm. And it took us 10mins via Grab to get back to Saigon Center for our drinks then!

Saigon dining treasure!
Jan 2023 • Family
What a delightful surprise find this restaurant is! Fresh and delicious ingredients - the seafood! - at a ridiculously cheap price. Serving sizes are also very generous. 

The food more than compensates for basic surroundings. Limited English skills from the very hospitable staff counteracted by pointing at menu (in English and on website) and Google translator. Part of the adventure being the only non-locals there!

After our first visit, we brought decent wine glasses and wine. No corkage, they provide an ice bucket. Perfection!

Local flavor
Dec 2022
This is a local restaurant specializing in fresh seafood. Hidden in a narrow yet vibrant street, 33 De Tham (street number) is a humble, unpretentious place with a largely local clientele. Every shellfish has a couple cooking methods to choose from. Taste is on the mild side. Portion is small but price is cheap even by Vietnamese standard. Around ten-minute taxi ride from the city centre.

Maybe a bit below average
Mar 2020 • Couples
We went to this restaurant based on the great TA recommendations but unfortunately this one did not live up to the hype. The restaurant is on two levels and we had a great table upstairs overlooking the street. The beers first ordered were not cold and that should have been an indication of what to expect. We ordered a variety of Vietnamese dishes but most were tasteless, a difficult feat to manage with Vietnamese cooking and although the portions were very large, we hardly ate them due to the poor quality. Better food on the street!!
